freeipmi.description: FreeIPMI publishes its releases as tarballs on the GNU ftp server and nowhere renovate has a datasource for.

customManagers.description: Update Dockerfile ARG versions annotated with a preceding '# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>' comment, e.g. freeipmi. A packageName after the depName keeps a long lookup path out of the commit subject.

packageRules.description: The FreeIPMI release listing links every tarball and its signature; only the tarball names carry a version.
